in_sanskrit.name: Tukuna
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Little Elephant
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Tukuna एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Tukuna is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'tukkana', meaning 'little elephant'. In Hindu culture, elephants are considered sacred animals and symbolize strength, power, and wisdom.
